## Body

F258 D1 at 8dd610594a1194320106f15233242e8764870b35: quiet settled panes average Q/30 captures per second, but backstops can synchronize into one Q-pane burst; active or Unknown/PendingClear panes retain per-pass captures. ObserverCounts excludes injection-owned captures and failed capture attempts. active_us is pass wall time, not process CPU; relaxed snapshots have field skew. Replay retains one extra composer string per pane and clones remembered/gate content, so only counters are allocation-free. Keep the busy-polling machine sampler separate from cumulative ps CPU windows and pin PID/start/commit across endpoints. The governed pr:313 verdict contains BEFORE and AFTER debt; per-thread SQLite CPU was not collected. magicWand: a read-only cost-receipt command exposing instrument timestamps and counter scope. Difficulties: dependency-free review gates fail with missing or ambient incompatible TS tools; use exact-head CI under C25 rather than linking dependencies.
